description: Read-only 3D-scene projection of the JCC Core session state for the Claw3D visual product. OPTIONAL VISUAL INTEGRATION: the external Claw3D product need not be installed for this contract, facade and tests to exist and pass; when it is absent the integration is reported as unavailable (see contract.external_product_available and claw3d/external.py::probe_external_product), which is not a blocker.
external_product_note: OPTIONAL VISUAL INTEGRATION: the external Claw3D product is NOT available on this host (probe: no loopback endpoint configured, no candidate executable on PATH, no matching uninstall entry -> product not installed here). This is not a blocker: the facade contract, the projection and the tests all exist and pass without it; see claw3d/external.py::probe_external_product for the live probe.

fields.note: Scene-graph node id = primary session identity (ADR-0003). Never cwd.
Agent that owns the session (node label).
Scorer score in [0,1] (drives node colour intensity).
Deterministic grid X from sha256(session_id) — no randomness.
Deterministic grid Y from sha256(session_id#y) — no randomness.
Deterministic grid Z from sha256(session_id#z) — no randomness.

name: jcc.claw3d
no_secrets: No control token, no API key, no signature, no nonce and no evidence payload is projected. The excluded-fields list above is the barrier and is asserted by tests/test_secret_leakage.py. Geometry is derived from the session id only.
ordering: nodes sorted by node_id ascending (canonical, independent of the store's updated_at ordering)
